summary.en: A separate round lock above the handle: key outside, thumb-turn inside, 1 in bolt throw. It is the single most retrofit-friendly lock in the world because the thumb-turn is accessible, standardised, and the door is already drilled.
summary.zh: 把手上方那个独立的圆形锁：外侧钥匙、内侧旋钮、方舌行程 1 英寸。它是全球最适合改造的锁，因为旋钮外露、标准化，而且门已经开好孔了。

en: Thumb-turn on the inside face — the part a retrofit motor grabs
Bolt with 1 in (25 mm) minimum throw
Strike and reinforcement plate in the frame
zh: 内侧旋钮——改造电机抓取的部分
方舌，最小行程 1 英寸（25 mm）
门框上的扣板与加强板

typical.en: 2-3/4 in (70 mm) standard; 2-3/8 in (60 mm) also sold
typical.zh: 标准为 2-3/4 英寸（70 mm）；也有 2-3/8 英寸（60 mm）

tolerance.en: Both are supported by most smart locks
tolerance.zh: 多数智能锁同时支持两种

how.en: Door edge to the centre of the bore.

typical.zh: 各等级均为 1 英寸（25.4 mm）

how.en: Throw the bolt fully and measure past the faceplate.
how.zh: 把方舌完全旋出后量突出量。

typical.en: Round knob, T-bar or coin-slot, 20–30 mm across
typical.zh: 圆钮、T 形杆或硬币槽，宽 20–30 mm

tolerance.en: This is the dimension adapter kits are built around
tolerance.zh: 适配件就是围绕这个尺寸设计的

how.en: Measure across the widest part and note the shape.

notes.en: Adhesive motor on the thumb-turn is a 5-minute install and needs no tools beyond a screwdriver. The engineering work is all in the turn-piece adapter library and in adhesive that survives a hot door in summer.
notes.zh: 把背胶电机贴在旋钮上是 5 分钟的安装，除了螺丝刀不需要工具。工程难点全在旋钮适配件库，以及能在夏季高温门面上存活的背胶。

en.q: Why do US smart locks not fit European doors?
en.a: They are built around a round bore with a thumb-turn. A euro cylinder door has neither, so the motor has nothing to grab and no bore to sit in.

en.q: What happens when the battery dies?
en.a: The outside key still works — that is the point of keeping a single-cylinder deadbolt rather than a keyless one.

zh.q: 为什么美制智能锁装不上欧洲的门？
zh.a: 它是围绕带旋钮的圆孔设计的。欧标锁芯门两者都没有，电机既无处抓取，也无处安装。
外侧钥匙仍能开——这正是保留单缸（外侧带钥匙孔）插销而不是纯无钥匙插销的意义。
